title: A transaction dependency, the current user and a membership check
problem: group_chat_api.py has finished routes for a group chat that use three dependencies you must write: get_tx (one Transaction per request, rolled back on errors), get_current_user (from the X-User-Id header) and get_member_chat (the chat from the path, if the user is a member).
requirements: get_tx yields one Transaction per request; on any exception it calls rollback() and re-raises the same exception; it always calls close(); it never commits (the routes do)
get_current_user reads the integer header X-User-Id and returns the user from USERS; missing or unknown id: 401 {"detail": "missing or unknown X-User-Id"}

get_member_chat takes chat_id from the path and depends on get_current_user; unknown chat: 404 {"detail": "chat not found"}; user not in chat["members"]: 403 {"detail": "not a member of this chat"}; otherwise returns the chat
Don't change the Transaction class or the routes
contract: get_tx() -> Generator[Transaction]; get_current_user(x_user_id from header) -> dict; get_member_chat(chat_id: int, user) -> dict
expectedBehavior: POST /chats/10/messages with X-User-Id: 1 -> 201 and tx_log == ["begin", "commit", "close"]; with X-User-Id: 3 -> 403; a batch with an empty text -> 422 with nothing stored and tx_log == ["begin", "rollback", "close"]
edgeCases: No header and an unknown user id are both 401
X-User-Id: ali is FastAPI's own 422 (loc header.x-user-id)
Unauthenticated request for an unknown chat: 401, not 404
Messages added before a failure in the same request are not stored
An unexpected exception must still reach the caller (not be swallowed)
Every transaction that begins is closed
hints: Conceptual: get_tx is a generator with setup, one yield, error handling and cleanup. get_member_chat is a sub-dependency: it declares the current user as its own parameter, which also makes authentication run first.

Specific: wrap the yield in try / except Exception / finally, and end the except block with a bare raise. Declare the header as Annotated[int | None, Header()] = None. get_member_chat's parameters are chat_id: int and the current user via Depends(get_current_user).

Implementation: in get_tx, create Transaction() before try; except: rollback() then raise; finally: close(). In get_member_chat: look the chat up with CHATS.get(chat_id), raise 404 if None, raise 403 if user["id"] not in chat["members"], else return chat.
evaluation: Authorisation builds on the current-user dependency instead of reading the header again
